stories.headline: Stora Enso sets a timetable for separating its Swedish forest business
stories.body: Stora Enso’s board approved a plan October 30 to separate its Swedish forest business into Bergslagets Skogar, a proposed listed company with more than 1.2 million hectares of forest land. Management will present the business at a November 3…

stories.headline: British Columbia forest-policy seminar examines what can change
stories.body: The University of British Columbia will host an open, in-person forest-policy seminar November 24, from noon to 1 p.m., in CAWP 2916, the Caseroom. The October 29 notice lists no online participation option.

stories.headline: Poor ocean conditions keep forest-nesting murrelet chicks exposed longer
stories.body: Oregon State University research links ocean feeding conditions to the time marbled murrelet chicks spend in forest nests. Published October 20 in Ornithology, the study found chicks took an average of eight additional days to fledge during…

featuredResource.title: EROI of Woody Biomass Heating Fuels in New York State
featuredResource.description: This one-page PDF infographic compares energy returned from wood heating with energy used to produce and deliver the fuel. It shows how feedstock, processing, transport distance and boiler efficiency influence wood-chip and pellet heating energy returns.
